exampleEn: She has a kind heart and a beautiful face.

hint: to record, to document, to write down (used for information, events, or personal thoughts)
exampleEn: I record my diary every day.

hint: drama (TV show, play)
exampleEn: I often watch Korean dramas.

hint: background, setting; context (can be literal or figurative)
exampleEn: This song has good background music.

hint: to slice, to chop, to cut (to cut into pieces)
exampleEn: I sliced the vegetables to cook.

hint: the West, Western countries (geographical/cultural)
exampleEn: I want to learn about Western culture.

hint: to suit, match; often used for clothes or people fitting in
exampleEn: These clothes suit me well.

hint: communication, telecommunication; refers to the exchange of information, especially via technology.
exampleEn: Information and communication technology has developed.

hint: reporter, journalist; often used in news contexts.
exampleEn: He is a famous scoop reporter.

hint: writer, author; a person who writes books, articles, etc.
exampleEn: I like famous novelists.

hint: broadcast, broadcasting; refers to media content and its dissemination.
exampleEn: That news was broadcast live.

hint: to be known, to be famous, to be reported; passive form of '알리다'.
exampleEn: His name became widely known.

hint: medium, media (channels of communication)
exampleEn: The mass media has great influence.

hint: to be used, to be written. Passive form of '쓰다'.
exampleEn: This is used as important data.

hint: to spread, to diffuse; used for information, rumors, smells, etc.
exampleEn: That rumor spread quickly.

hint: screen, display, scene; refers to visual displays or scenes in media.
exampleEn: The computer screen looks bright.

hint: to appear, emerge, debut; used for new things or people coming into view
exampleEn: A new character appeared on stage.

hint: to be published, to be carried (in print). Passive form related to media publication.
meaningEn: to be published, to be carried (in print)
exampleEn: His writing was published in the magazine.

hint: worldview, view of the world; philosophical or cultural perspective
exampleKo: 이 소설은 독특한 세계관을 가지고 있다.
exampleEn: This novel has a unique worldview.

hint: play, drama, theater; refers to the performance or the art form.
exampleKo: 우리는 어제 연극 공연을 보러 갔다.
exampleEn: We went to see a play performance yesterday.

hint: direction, supervision, management. Primarily used for film directors or project managers.
exampleEn: That movie was made by a famous director.

hint: stage, scene, arena (physical platform for performance or a metaphorical setting)
exampleEn: The singer went on stage and sang a song.

hint: beauty, beautifulness; often used in compound words related to aesthetics
exampleEn: The painting contains outstanding beauty.

hint: scene, situation (often in movies, plays, or specific events)
exampleEn: The last scene of the movie was impressive.

hint: movement, motion, action; refers to physical actions or gestures.
exampleEn: He suddenly stopped his movement.

hint: code (computer, secret); also cord, chord
exampleEn: This is a secret cipher code.

hint: understanding, comprehension; crucial for academic and interpersonal contexts.
exampleEn: It is important to understand each other's position.

hint: example, instance; used to illustrate a point or concept
exampleEn: Please explain with a good example.

hint: relation, connection, association; often used with ~와/과 관련하여/관련되다
exampleKo: 이 사건과 관련된 정보를 찾고 있습니다.
exampleEn: I am looking for information related to this incident.

hint: to take (time), to be hung, to catch (a disease), to be caught
meaningEn: to take (time), to be hung, to catch
exampleKo: 이 일을 끝내는 데 시간이 오래 걸립니다.
exampleEn: It takes a long time to finish this work.

hint: to be correct/right, to fit (size, situation), to be suitable
meaningEn: to be correct, to fit, to be suitable
exampleEn: His claim does not match the facts.

hint: to be achieved/realized (dreams, goals), to be formed/composed of
meaningEn: to be achieved/realized; to be formed/composed of
exampleEn: His dream was finally realized.

hint: to get, obtain, gain (often abstract things like results, information, experience)
exampleEn: I was able to gain a lot of experience.

hint: to achieve, to accomplish (a goal, dream); to form, to constitute (a group, harmony)
exampleEn: He really wants to achieve his goal.

hint: change, transformation (an alteration or modification)
exampleEn: Social change is very important.

hint: to reveal (truth, fact), to clarify; to light up (a place)
meaningEn: to reveal, clarify; to light up
exampleEn: The police revealed the cause of the incident.

hint: meaning, significance, sense; crucial for interpreting and conveying ideas
exampleEn: I don't know the meaning of this word.

hint: content, substance, details; refers to what is contained or expressed
exampleEn: I summarized the main content of the book.

hint: result, outcome, consequence; crucial for cause-and-effect discussions
exampleEn: The test results came out well.

hint: more than, above (quantity); ideal (as a noun or adjective form 이상적)
exampleEn: I bought more than ten apples.

hint: method, way, means; crucial for problem-solving and explanations
exampleKo: 이 문제를 해결할 좋은 방법이 있어요.
exampleEn: There is a good way to solve this problem.

hint: without (something); often used with nouns or verb stems
exampleEn: We cannot live without water.

hint: to appear, to emerge, to manifest; used for physical and abstract appearances
exampleEn: A strange sound suddenly appeared.

hint: to be based on, to be due to; often used in the form ~에 의하여/의해
meaningEn: to be based on, to be due to
exampleEn: This is based on the expert's opinion.

hint: point, aspect, feature; often used to discuss pros/cons or specific points
exampleEn: That is a very important point.

hint: fact, truth; often used as an adverbial phrase (사실은, 사실대로)
exampleEn: Actually, I arrived first.

hint: to be seen, to appear; also to show (something to someone)
meaningEn: to be seen, to appear; to show
exampleEn: That movie is really well shown.

hint: degree, extent, level; often used with ~ㄹ/을 정도
exampleEn: I can understand it to some extent.

hint: to go through, to communicate, to be understood; often used as ~을/를 통해(서)
exampleEn: We understand each other through conversation.

hint: case, instance, situation; often used with ~는 경우
exampleEn: I have never seen this kind of case.

hint: to do for, to be for the sake of (someone/something); often used as ~을/를 위해(서)
meaningEn: to do for, for the sake of
exampleEn: I work hard for my family.

hint: value, worth, merit; can be economic, ethical, or personal.
exampleEn: That item has high value.

hint: repeatedly, again and again (adverb)
exampleEn: He makes mistakes again and again.

hint: Future; refers to time ahead.
exampleEn: It is important to make future plans.

hint: To be related to, involved in; connects concepts or people.
meaningEn: to be related to, involved in
exampleEn: This is related to that incident.

hint: to include, to contain; used when something is part of a larger whole.
exampleEn: This price includes tax.

hint: to look for, to search for, to visit; implies active searching for information or places.
meaningEn: to look for, search for, visit
exampleEn: I am in the middle of looking for information.

hint: main, principal, major; often modifies nouns like 'events', 'reasons', 'factors'.
exampleEn: That is the main cause.

hint: to reach, extend, affect (often used with '영향')
exampleEn: The news reached the whole country.

hint: first, primarily, for now; indicates the first or most important action/consideration
exampleEn: Let's handle this first.

hint: currently, at present; refers to the present time or state
exampleEn: The current situation is very serious.

hint: itself, inherent (emphasizing the thing in question, distinct from external factors)
exampleEn: This is the problem itself.

hint: face, surface, aspect. Used to refer to different sides or aspects of a topic.
exampleEn: There are difficulties in terms of the economy.

hint: realistic, practical; describes something grounded in reality and achievable.
exampleEn: We must set realistic goals.

hint: process, course, procedure (a series of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular end)
exampleEn: The learning process is very important.

hint: situation, state of affairs, circumstances (a set of conditions or circumstances)
exampleEn: We need to grasp the current situation.

hint: structure, organization, framework. The way something is arranged or organized.
exampleEn: The social structure is complex.

hint: consciousness, awareness, mind (abstract concept related to perception and thought)
exampleEn: Social awareness is necessary.

hint: claim, assertion, argument (a statement put forward as true or right)
exampleEn: He did not yield his own claim.

hint: to be caused by, to result from, to stem from (indicates causality)
meaningEn: to be caused by, to stem from
exampleEn: This problem stems from various factors.

hint: to exist, to be; states the fact of existence
exampleEn: Many problems exist in this world.

hint: viewpoint, perspective, standpoint
exampleEn: Let's think from a different viewpoint.

hint: to not mind, to disregard, to despite; used in ~에도 불구하고
exampleEn: Despite the difficulties, he succeeded.

hint: to grasp, understand, figure out (implies deep understanding or analysis)
exampleEn: We must accurately grasp the problem.

hint: practice, action, implementation; often used with 'plan' or 'method'
exampleEn: We must put theory into practice.

hint: plan, measure, proposal; often refers to a method or solution
exampleEn: We need to seek a solution plan.
